verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents a Common Criteria EAL 6+ certified secure element in the Nitrokey 3 (nitrokey-docs-16), satisfying the certification half of the story, but there is no mention anywhere in the evidence of FIPS 140 validation, nor any documented water/crush-resistance or ruggedization specs. Community hands-on feedback actively undercuts the durability angle, describing the U2F key as feeling 'flimsy' compared to competitors (nitrokey-comm-3, nitrokey-comm-4). Missing for 10: FIPS 140 validation evidence, explicit IP/MIL-STD or water/crush durability specs, and independent corroboration of ruggedness rather than community complaints about build quality.
